lead: The coverage gate credits a class reached through a `?Instance` return or a `foreach` element to no case at all.
body: `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/corpus/mod.rs`'s `Attribution` follows only a bare `Instance` return and the class's name written in the case, so a case that reads `Core\Ldap\Entry` through `read()` or a search loop counts as zero for it. Write the type on the variable, `?Core\Ldap\Entry $admin = $corp->read(...)` or `foreach ($found as Core\Ldap\Entry $entry)`, and the case counts.
